channel.title: RVA Burlesque
channel.description: Burlesque shows in Richmond, VA. Confirmed dates only; tentative [TBD] dates are kept out of the feed until firmed up.

item.title: 4th Annual GAY ALL DAY! Burlesque & Variety Show
item.description:
When: Saturday, June 20, 2026 · 7pm – 10pm

Where: Gallery5, 200 West Marshall Street, Richmond, VA 23220

Cost: $10-$25 sliding scale

The 4th annual queer pride burlesque and variety show featuring local LGBTQ+ performers, co-produced by RadQueer Productions, Pink Faerie Productions, and others. Doors at 7 PM, show at 8 PM; part of the Queer All Weekend festival.

item.title: 4th Annual GAY ALL DAY! Burlesque & Variety Show
item.description:
When: Saturday, June 20, 2026 · 8pm – 10pm

Where: Gallery5, 200 W Marshall St, Richmond, VA 23220

Cost: $10-$25 sliding scale

LGBTQ+ burlesque and variety show featuring local talent as part of the 4th Annual GAY ALL DAY! Pride weekend fest. Doors at 7 PM, show at 8 PM, sliding scale tickets $10-$25.

item.title: RÉVÉLER CABARET: RODEO EDITION
item.description:
When: Friday, June 26, 2026 · 8pm – 10:30pm

Where: Révéler, 3108 W Cary St, Richmond, VA 23221

Cost: $35

PRIDE goes country with a magical, intoxicating cabaret show featuring country vocalist Martha Spencer & The Wonderland Country Band, burlesque dancers, and emcee Qing Blaze. An evening of lush performance artistry and wild surprises.

item.title: Pours and Pasties
item.description:
When: Saturday, June 27, 2026 · 8:30pm – 11pm

Where: Strangeways Brewing, 3110 W Leigh Street, Richmond, VA, 23230

Cost: $15 advance / $20 door / $22 VIP

Burlesque Right Meow returns to Strangeways Brewing in Scott's Addition for a night of glitter, giggles, and tantalizing talent featuring Chartreuse Divinity, Draven DeMoan, Edie Sativa, Ganja Kitty, Kayy Lovely, Nostra-Dad-Ass, and Scarlet Starlet, hosted by Conejita Luxxe. Doors at 8:30pm, show at 9pm; 21+ only.

item.title: Villain Era: A Burlesque Tribute to Bad Witches and Bitches
item.description:
When: Friday, July 3, 2026 · 8pm – 10pm

Where: Firehouse Theatre, 1609 West Broad Street, Richmond, VA 23220

Cost: $20

Villain Era returns to Firehouse Theatre featuring captivating criminals, wicked witches, power-hungry queens, and iconic antagonists in an 18+ burlesque and variety showcase hosted by Holly Pocket.

item.title: BRAS
item.description:
When: Saturday, July 11, 2026 · 7pm

Where: Ember Music Hall, 309 East Broad Street, Richmond, VA 23219

Cost: $39.40 to $84.20

Burlesque and variety tribute to The Fast and The Furious franchise, where performers drift through daring acts, strip down faster than a quarter-mile run, and transform iconic characters and plot twists into a night of entertainment that is equal parts sexy, hilarious, and over-the-top.

item.title: The Big Ga(y)me Burlesque
item.description:
When: Saturday, July 18, 2026 · 7pm – 11pm

Where: Gallery5, 200 West Marshall Street, Richmond, VA 23220

Sports-themed queer burlesque night featuring acts inspired by hockey, baseball, Olympics, and World Cup. Produced by Pink Faeries with Poppy la Fae; hosted by Zorro Nova. Doors at 8pm, show at 9pm. 18+ only.

item.title: Studio 8: A Disco Burlesque Experience
item.description:
When: Friday, August 21, 2026 · 8pm – 11pm

Where: Gallery5, 200 West Marshall Street, Richmond, VA 23220

Presented by Onyx & 8th, this one-night-only birthday celebration transforms Gallery5 into a shimmering disco world of burlesque, showgirl glamour, mirrorballs, and immersive performance. Doors at 8pm, show at 9pm. 18+ only.
